BiblicalUsage: The sense of sâbâʻ is copiousness. It stands in Ecclesiastes 5:12, "…a labouring man sweet, whether he eat little…", and in Genesis 41:29, "Behold, there come seven years of great plenty…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sâbâʻ counts, because God put it in his book.
